info.description:
Relative flood vulnerability of Nairobi County roads. Scores are a static planning aid derived from elevation, slope, river proximity and surface; they are not a flood forecast, a flood probability or a measured flood risk.

**Access.** Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session is an HTTP-only cookie. All road, statistics and metadata routes need a session; `/admin` routes need an administrator.

**Geometry.** GeoJSON in EPSG:4326 (longitude, latitude).

**Lists** are paginated with `limit` and `offset` and report `pagination.total`.

**Errors** always have the body `{"detail": "..."}`; validation errors (422) add an `errors` list.
info.title: AquaMap API
